capabilities: Edit Markdown notes as slide decks with a thumbnail rail
Reorder, add, duplicate, move, and delete slides with undo
Edit titles and subtitles directly in the slide preview
Keep private presenter notes in [!slide] callouts
Present full-screen and export decks to PDF
extras: Not yet listed in Obsidian's Community Plugins directory; manual install from GitHub releases (Obsidian 1.7.2+). Deleted headings leave <!-- just-simple-slides:empty-heading --> markers in the source; PDF export is desktop-only.
motivation: The author built it because Markdown is the right format for content, but 'what was missing was a visual editor for working with that content as a presentation.'
problem: Obsidian can render Markdown as slides, but offers no visual way to see, reorder, or title slides or to keep presenter notes while editing the content.
summary: Visual editor for Markdown presentations in Obsidian with slide thumbnails, automatic layouts, private notes, and a themed full-screen player.
